learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to use vibrant colors and shapes to show the loud and happy sounds of a grand celebration!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we celebrate, there is loud music and laughter! We can show this in our art by using very bright colors like red, yellow, and neon pink.
We can add confetti, balloons, and musical notes floating in the air to make our drawing look like a big, happy party!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Party on Paper
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a big radio playing your favorite song. Around it, draw tiny floating musical notes and colorful balloons!

quick_recap: ⭐ We use bright, warm colors to show excitement and celebration.
⭐ Adding little details like stars and confetti makes the picture pop.
⭐ Art lets us capture the happy memories of singing together!
